name: P² streaming quantile marker estimator
definition: For internal marker i with integer rank n_i and movement d=±1, q'_i=q_i+d/(n_(i+1)−n_(i−1))[(n_i−n_(i−1)+d)(q_(i+1)−q_i)/(n_(i+1)−n_i)+(n_(i+1)−n_i−d)(q_i−q_(i−1))/(n_i−n_(i−1))]
variables: q marker heights; n marker ranks; d signed one-step adjustment
assumptions: Finite ordered scalar observations, 0<p<1; initialization and update details pending review
limitations: Heuristic approximation, order sensitivity; review pending
failure_conditions: Invalid marker positions or nonfinite observations
